text:
meera: Quick thought + mock: instead of hiding spikes fully, add a small "axis inset" control on the right of the y-axis that shows the clipped range (e.g. 0-200) and a collapsed badge for the outliers (e.g. "+3 ▾"). Clicking it expands a mini-viewport showing the extreme points and their timestamps. Screenshot: figs/axis-inset.png

tony: Nice. This avoids re-scaling the whole chart while keeping spikes discoverable. Microcopy idea: badge text '+3 outliers' or '+3 points' — prefer 'outliers' for clarity.

kevin: A couple UX constraints: 1) When smoothing is toggled on, indicate whether the inset shows smoothed or raw values. Maybe a tiny 'raw'/'smoothed' toggle inside the inset. 2) For unit labels, keep axis unit (ms, req/s) visible; if we clip we should show a tiny truncated label '200+ ms' on the inset.

zara: A11y: the inset must be keyboard focusable and announced as 'Axis inset: 3 outliers hidden. Press Enter to expand'. Suggest aria markup: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Axis inset: 3 outliers hidden">+3 ▾</button>. When expanded, focus moves into the mini-viewport.

tony: Analytics: track `axis_inset_open` + `axis_inset_reason` where reason is `auto_clip` or `manual_clip` or `user_toggle`. We need to see if people use inset or just ignore it.

meera: Behavior Q: auto-detect clipping vs manual only? I'm leaning toward auto-suggest banner once per-chart: 'Large values detected. Show outliers in axis inset?' with 'Enable'/'No thanks' options. Default off.

kevin: Agree default off. Also add a legend context menu: 'Show clipped values inline' to create a derived small table below chart for power users.

zara: Keyboard shortcut idea: when legend row focused, press 'i' to toggle inset focus for that series. Document in help. Also ensure screen reader reads the expanded list items as 'timestamp - value'.

devbot: deploy-bot: Mock assets uploaded to staging://figs/axis-inset-v2.png at 1769000180.

meera: Visual note: inset background should be soft and not steal attention. Use same series color for markers. If smoothing is active, show dashed smoothing line inside inset. Also provide a 'show on main chart' link to temporarily overlay outliers on top of the scaled chart.

tony: Edge case: stacked charts and percentages. We should disable axis inset for stacked-percent views and show tooltip: 'Axis inset not available for stacked views'.

kevin: For unit truncation and hover: when axis shows '200+ ms' hovering should show exact value list in the inset plus relative percent vs median. Good for debugging.

zara: Accessibility test plan: keyboard navigation, NVDA/VoiceOver announcements for inset open/close, focus trapping while inset is open, and ensure the inset content is reachable in the DOM (no aria-hidden).

meera: I'll update mocks with two copy variants and add the aria snippet + keyboard flow in annotations. Posting updated frames shortly. Thanks! :+1:
